short: binary-level integration tests with a fake gh
is: Integration tests that run the built zaf binary in a temp project against a scripted fake gh and, for slices, a throwaway jj repository with a bare remote.
conventions: Each test crate does `mod common;` and builds a Project (temp root, .zaf.toml, gh scene) from common/mod.rs

fs.name: cli_board.rs
fs.role: board verbs: terse and JSON forms, exits 0, 1, 2

fs.name: cli_slice.rs
fs.role: slice open, changes, slice pr, slice merge end to end

fs.name: common/
fs.role: shared Project harness and jj helper

fs.name: ways_manifest.rs
fs.role: the ways repo's own .zaf.toml loads, ZAF.toml is gone, and doctor finds every needed action in the project tier with no machine dependency

notes: fixtures/gh reads a FAKE_GH_DIR scene: a rules file of glob, exit code and response file; calls/ records each argv; an unmatched call exits 97
src/adapters/github/tests.rs also uses fixtures/gh, so it is shared with unit tests
cli_slice needs a real jj on PATH
